items.title_zh: 芝加哥大学教授：AI 时代数学人才招聘将更看重研究愿景与表达能力
items.title_en: University of Chicago Professor: AI-Era Math Hiring Will Value Research Vision and Communication Skills More
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，人工智能正在降低数学研究取得突破的门槛，但这也意味着，学术界可能需要重新审视人才招聘方式。芝加哥大学一位知名数学教授认为，未来招聘数学研究人员时，个人交流能力和清晰表达研究构想的能力将变得更加重要。 芝加哥大学数学领域的杰出学者弗兰克 · 卡莱加里（Frank Calegari）近日在一篇文章中谈到了自己对研究人员的招聘标准。他写道：“我想了解你希望数学走向何方，也需要具备能解释这为何可能实现的专业能力。” 卡莱加里担忧，随着人工智能工具不断进步，学术界各个领域的初级研究岗位可能会被一些学生占据，而这些人之所以能够获得相关成果，可能只是因为他们大量使用人工智能生成证明。 不过，他认为，一场 30 分钟的面对面交流，就足以区分两类候选人：一类只是批量制造低质量研究成果的人，另一类则拥有清晰的研究愿景，并且善于表达。 卡莱加里在发布于陶哲轩（Terence Tao）博客上的文章中表示： “招聘流程将不得不更多地依赖人与人之间的直接交流，而不是仅仅审查书面材料。” 他还批评了一些他所称的“懒惰的评审委员会”，认为这些委员会过去仅凭一篇论文或一项学术成果就决定是否录用学生，而如今，这类成果完全可能由人工智能生成。 他表示：“一旦我们采取这种方式，就有责任培养自己的研究生，让他们具备更好的数学表达能力。我们本应更加认真地对待这件事。” 上个月，康奈尔大学教授史蒂文 · 斯特罗加茨（Steven Strogatz）也曾指出，具备“rizz”（俚语，意为个人魅力）特质的数学家如今更受重视，因为他们能够解释人工智能生成的研究结果，并以此提出新的数学问题。 IT之家注意到，人工智能公司迅速进军数学领域，已经让不少数学研究人员感到不安和困惑。随着 OpenAI 向这一领域大量推出针对世界上最复杂数学难题的解决方案，数量达到数百项，整个数学界都在思考如何在人工智能时代保持自身价值。 一些教授已经明确表示不再使用人工智能。不过，大多数人仍在尝试寻找将这项技术融入自身研究的方法。 美国各地的学生也在努力适应这一变化，并要求教授明确公布人工智能使用指南，说明学生是否可以使用这类工具，以及应该如何使用。 一名学生在麻省理工学院（MIT）近期开展的一项调查中写道：“整个学术界目前缺乏高层次的领导和指导。”
items.summary_en: AI is lowering the threshold for breakthroughs in mathematical research, but this may also mean academia needs to rethink how it recruits talent. Frank Calegari, a prominent mathematics scholar at the University of Chicago, believes that personal communication skills and the ability to clearly articulate a research vision will become more important when hiring mathematics researchers in the future. He wrote: 'I want to understand where you want mathematics to go, and I also need the expertise to explain why that is possible.' He worries that as AI tools improve, junior research positions across academia may be filled by students who obtain results largely by using AI extensively to generate proofs. However, he believes a 30-minute face-to-face conversation is enough to distinguish candidates who mass-produce low-quality research outputs from those with a clear research vision who are good at expressing it. In an article published on Terence Tao's blog, Calegari said the hiring process will have to rely more on direct person-to-person communication rather than merely reviewing written materials. He also criticized what he called 'lazy review committees' that in the past decided whether to hire a student based on a single paper or academic result, which today could be entirely generated by AI. He said: 'Once we adopt this approach, we have a responsibility to train our own graduate students so that they have better mathematical expression skills. We should have taken this more seriously.' Last month, Cornell University professor Steven Strogatz also noted that mathematicians with 'rizz'—slang for personal charisma—are now more valued because they can explain AI-generated research results and use them to pose new mathematical questions. IT Home noted that AI companies' rapid entry into mathematics has left many mathematics researchers uneasy and confused. As OpenAI has pushed hundreds of solutions to the world's most complex mathematical problems into the field, the mathematics community is thinking about how to maintain its value in the AI era. Some professors have explicitly said they will no longer use AI. However, most are still trying to find ways to integrate the technology into their research. Students across the United States are also trying to adapt to the change and are asking professors to clearly publish AI usage guidelines explaining whether students may use such tools and how they should be used. One student wrote in a recent MIT survey: 'There is currently a lack of high-level leadership and guidance across academia.'
items.why_zh: 若卡莱加里的判断成立，AI 生成证明可能改变数学人才评估标准，使面试和表达能力更重要；这仍是一位学者的观点（推测）。
items.why_en: If Calegari's view proves correct, AI-generated proofs could change how math talent is evaluated, making interviews and communication skills more important; this remains one scholar's opinion (speculative).

items.title_zh: GitHub 推出新 Git 存储架构：内部测试单个代码仓库支持 5000 个智能体同时协作，每秒处理 7200 次推送
items.title_en: GitHub unveils new Git storage architecture: internal test supports 5,000 agents collaborating in one repo and 7,200 pushes per second
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，GitHub 发布博文，称上周在 GitHub Universe 大会上，正式公布了全新的 Git 存储架构，代号“Rubicon”。 官方表示，该架构不仅具备每秒处理数千次写入的能力，还能实现读取按需水平扩展。经内部压力测试验证，新架构能够在保持极低读取延迟的同时， 支持单个代码仓库容纳 5000 个智能体（Agent）并发协作，并承受每秒高达 7200 次的代码推送 。 IT之家获悉，该架构目前已经开启 小范围定向内测（limited private preview） ，并计划于 明年初逐步扩大开放范围 。 据介绍，如今 GitHub 上最繁忙的代码仓库，其单秒写入峰值最多也不过数十次，且往往呈现短暂脉冲式的突发状态。然而，随着越来越多的研发工作交由全天候高并发运行的 AI 智能体处理，预计在未来一年内，这种瞬时突发将演变为常态化的持续高吞吐负载。 每一次代码推送（Push）都会级联触发更多的读取请求：CI 流水线即刻启动、部署系统拉取最新提交，其他协同智能体也会同步获取代码作为上下文。这种读操作的扇出扩散（Read Fan-out），随着写入频率的攀升，对平台整体流量产生了极为显著的放大效应。 在流量分布曲线最顶端的头部仓库中，这一趋势已然显现。下方图表展示了 GitHub 上某个典型代码仓库在 3 月至 5 月期间的日请求量变化 —— 短短两个月内，其流量便激增了约 4 倍；此后至今，其访问增长更始终维持着陡峭的指数级上升轨迹。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, GitHub said in a Nov 5 blog post that it officially unveiled a new Git storage architecture codenamed “Rubicon” at GitHub Universe last week. GitHub says the architecture can handle thousands of writes per second and scale reads horizontally on demand. Internal stress tests verified that it can support 5,000 agents collaborating concurrently in a single repository while maintaining very low read latency, and withstand up to 7,200 code pushes per second. The architecture is now in limited private preview, with broader access planned to expand gradually early next year. GitHub says the busiest repositories today peak at only dozens of writes per second, often in short bursts; but as more development work is handled by AI agents running around the clock at high concurrency, such bursts are expected to become sustained high-throughput loads within the next year. Every push triggers cascading reads: CI pipelines start immediately, deployment systems pull the latest commits, and other collaborating agents fetch code as context; this read fan-out amplifies overall platform traffic as write frequency rises. GitHub says this trend is already visible among top repositories: one typical repository's daily requests grew about fourfold from March to May, and access growth has since maintained a steep exponential trajectory.
items.why_zh: 推测：若 AI 智能体持续高并发写入成为常态，代码托管平台需重构存储与读扩展架构。
items.why_en: Speculation: if sustained high-concurrency writes by AI agents become normal, code hosting platforms will need to redesign storage and read-scaling architectures.

items.title_zh: Claude Max 订阅套餐使用额度被指“虚标”，Anthropic 辩词未获法官采纳
items.title_en: Claude Max usage limits alleged to be misleading; judge rejects Anthropic's defense
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，美国联邦治安法官谢文辉（Alex Tse）裁定，Anthropic 必须继续应对 Claude Max 套餐使用额度涉嫌误导消费者的主要指控。据 Courthouse News 报道，谢文辉周五驳回了案件中的其他几项诉求。 Anthropic 宣传称，月费 100 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 668.6 元人民币） 和 200 美元 （现汇率约合 1,337 元人民币） 的 Max 套餐，使用额度 分别是 Pro 套餐的 5 倍和 20 倍 。但今年 6 月提起诉讼的消费者指控，如果按整周计算，实际额度 远远达不到宣传中的倍数 。 两名原告卡尔 · 卡恩和所罗门 · 史密斯计算发现，以 Claude 的一款模型为例，200 美元 （现汇率约合 1,337 元人民币） 套餐的每周额度 只有 Pro 套餐的 6 倍 ，100 美元 （现汇率约合 668.6 元人民币） 套餐 则为 3.5 倍 。 问题出在额度计算方式上。Max 用户每 5 小时的使用额度确实可以达到 Pro 用户的 5 倍或 20 倍，但每周的使用上限并没有同比例增加。 Anthropic 辩称，消费者应该明白，宣传中的倍数 指的是单次使用周期的额度 ，并援引帮助页面作为依据。谢文辉并未采纳这一说法。裁决书写道：“Anthropic 对单次使用周期的说明，需要从 claude.com 的主要销售页面点击两次链接才能看到。” 谢文辉认为，既然消费者按月支付订阅费，就有理由认为 Anthropic 承诺的使用额度也是按月计算 。因此，原告可以继续追究 Anthropic 涉嫌过失性虚假陈述和违约的责任。 相关阅读： 《 美国消费者指控 Claude Max 订阅套餐额度“虚标”，拟对 Anthropic 发起集体诉讼 》
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, U.S. Magistrate Judge Alex Tse ruled that Anthropic must continue to face the main claims that Claude Max plan usage limits are misleading to consumers; Courthouse News reported that Tse dismissed several other claims in the case on Friday. Anthropic advertised that its $100 and $200 per month Max plans offer 5x and 20x the usage of the Pro plan. But consumers who sued in June allege that, measured on a weekly basis, actual limits fall far short of the advertised multiples. Two plaintiffs, Carl Kahn and Solomon Smith, calculated that for one Claude model, the $200 plan's weekly limit was only 6x Pro, and the $100 plan was 3.5x. The issue is how limits are calculated: Max users can indeed get 5x or 20x Pro usage per 5-hour period, but weekly caps do not increase proportionally. Anthropic argued that consumers should understand the advertised multiples refer to a single usage period's limit and cited its help page. Tse did not accept this, writing that “Anthropic's explanation of the single usage period requires two clicks from the main sales page on claude.com to see.” Tse reasoned that since consumers pay subscription fees monthly, they have reason to believe Anthropic's promised usage limits are also calculated monthly. The plaintiffs can therefore continue to pursue claims of negligent misrepresentation and breach of contract.

items.why_en: Speculation: the ruling could affect how subscription AI services disclose usage-limit advertising, but the case has not been decided.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据《金融时报》昨天报道，尽管美国科技股近期遭遇剧烈波动，Anthropic 仍在推进上市计划。这家来自美国的人工智能初创企业，已经做好接受低于乐观预期估值的准备。 据多位 Anthropic 投资者透露，这家美国公司仍计划在感恩节前进行 IPO（首次公开募股），预计募资 800 亿美元-1,000 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,352.66 亿元- 6,690.83 亿元人民币） ，目标估值为 1.25 万亿美元-1.75 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.36 万亿元- 11.71 万亿元人民币） 。 上述传闻中数字高于 Anthropic 目前的 9,650 亿美元 （现汇率约合 6.46 万亿元人民币） 估值， 但与投资者一个月前预计的翻倍水平相比存在不小差距 。 一位持有大量 Anthropic 股份的投资者表示：“我认为他们会采取非常保守的定价策略，比如将估值定在 1.5 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 10.04 万亿元人民币） ，然后再逐步上涨。”其他参与此次交易的人士则认为估值可能更低， 约为 1.3 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.7 万亿元人民币） 。 这种预期下调反映出科技行业正在重新评估市场走势。投资者们越来越担心借贷成本上升，以及 AI 企业不断膨胀的支出计划。大量 AI 概念股已经开始出现抛售现象，贷款机构也开始回避高风险项目。 本周美国中期选举，民主党取得压倒性胜利，部分原因在于该党候选人承诺阻止数据中心建设。这种结果进一步加速了市场抛售。 六名以上投资者透露，Anthropic 仍打算上市， CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫迪为此不得不接受估值下调 。 本周四美国股市剧烈震荡，单日蒸发 3.2 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 21.41 万亿元人民币） 市值。以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数暴跌 6.4%，市场担忧 AI 基础设施投资热潮可能放缓。 市场研究机构 Vital Knowledge 分析师表示：“AI 股票遭到抛售，这让 Anthropic 上市变得更加困难，意味着可用于资本支出的资金减少，进而引发更多抛售。” 同时 OpenAI 也难以完成自己的私募融资。该公司已将寻求的估值从 1.4 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 9.37 万亿元人民币） 下调至 1.25 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 8.36 万亿元人民币） ，同时将融资规模从 300 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,007.25 亿元人民币） 缩减至 200 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,338.17 亿元人民币） 。 Anthropic 的支持者希望，本次 IPO 能够吸引一些被动卖家，即指数基金和大型资产管理公司。这些机构目前尚未持有 Anthropic 的股票，但在公司上市后不久，他们实际上将不得不买入相关股票。 此外 Anthropic 冲击“史上最大 IPO”的传闻也有变数。 据多位了解阿莫迪想法的人士透露 ， 他对超越马斯克 SpaceX 并没有太大兴趣 。 一位投资者表示：“他们并不在乎估值能否超过 SpaceX，也不追求 IPO 融资规模最大化。”Anthropic 的七位联合创始人已经承诺，将个人持有的公司股权中的 80% 捐赠给慈善事业。
items.summary_en: According to the Financial Times, despite recent sharp volatility in US tech stocks, Anthropic is still pushing ahead with its IPO plan and is prepared to accept a valuation below optimistic expectations. Several investors said the company still plans to hold its IPO before Thanksgiving, expecting to raise US$80 billion to US$100 billion, with a target valuation of US$1.25 trillion to US$1.75 trillion. These reported figures are higher than Anthropic's current US$965 billion valuation but well below the doubled level investors had expected a month ago. One investor holding a large stake said the company may adopt very conservative pricing, for example setting the valuation at US$1.5 trillion first and then letting it rise gradually; other people involved in the deal believe the valuation could be lower, around US$1.3 trillion. The lowered expectations reflect the tech industry's reassessment of the market: investors are increasingly worried about rising borrowing costs and AI companies' expanding spending plans, AI-related stocks have seen sell-offs, and lenders are starting to avoid high-risk projects. In this week's US midterm elections, Democrats won a landslide victory, partly because their candidates promised to block data center construction; this further accelerated the market sell-off. More than six investors said Anthropic still intends to go public, and CEO Dario Amodei has had to accept a valuation cut. On Thursday, US stocks swung sharply, losing US$3.2 trillion in market value in a single day; the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 plunged 6.4% as the market worried that the AI infrastructure investment boom could slow. Analysts at Vital Knowledge said the sell-off in AI stocks makes Anthropic's IPO more difficult, meaning less money available for capital expenditure, which in turn triggers more selling. At the same time, OpenAI is also struggling to complete its private financing. It has lowered the valuation it is seeking from US$1.4 trillion to US$1.25 trillion and reduced the financing size from US$30 billion to US$20 billion. Anthropic's supporters hope the IPO can attract passive buyers such as index funds and large asset managers. In addition, the reported bid for the 'largest IPO ever' also faces uncertainty. People familiar with Amodei's thinking said he is not very interested in surpassing Elon Musk's SpaceX. One investor said: 'They don't care whether the valuation exceeds SpaceX's, nor do they seek to maximize the IPO fundraising size.' Anthropic's seven co-founders have pledged to donate 80% of their personally held company equity to charity.
items.why_zh: 若报道属实，这将是 AI 热潮下备受关注的上市交易，但在市场抛售和估值下调背景下仍存变数；信息来自匿名投资者，尚未获官方确认（推测）。
items.why_en: If the report is accurate, this would be a closely watched IPO amid the AI boom, but it remains uncertain amid sell-offs and valuation cuts; the information comes from unnamed investors and has not been officially confirmed (speculative).

items.title_zh: 埃森哲报告被曝存在虚假引用案例，公司否认系 AI 幻觉所致
items.title_en: Accenture Report Allegedly Contains Fake Citations; Company Denies AI Hallucinations Caused Them
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，埃森哲（Accenture）被指发布了一份充斥人工智能“幻觉”的研究报告，其中不仅包含大量虚假信息，还出现了多处疑似捏造的研究案例。 据 GPTZero 最新分析，这家咨询巨头发布的一份报告涉嫌包含 15 条虚假引用，以及完全虚构的案例研究，因此正受到外界审查。 这份名为《跨越式发展》（Leapfrogging Development）的报告由埃森哲与马德里 IE 大学的研究人员合作发布，旨在探讨人工智能如何提高非洲农业产业的生产力。 埃森哲否认相关错误是由人工智能造成的。 不过，这一事件仍可能令埃森哲陷入尴尬境地。此前，该公司管理层曾威胁称，不愿使用人工智能的员工可能面临解雇。 埃森哲首席执行官朱莉 · 斯威特（Julie Sweet）去年曾警告称，作为公司人工智能转型工作的一部分，未能使用这项技术的顾问将被公司“淘汰”。 GPTZero 的报告凸显了咨询行业日益广泛使用人工智能所引发的担忧。其中一个风险在于，人工智能“幻觉”可能通过聊天机器人回答和摘要传播虚假信息，进而“污染信息源”。 GPTZero 表示：“该公司认为，虚构引用对研究人员、学者、顾问、学生，以及任何通过互联网搜索信息的人而言，都是迫在眉睫的现实威胁。” 这并非咨询行业首次出现类似事件。此前，德勤、安永、毕马威和普华永道等大型咨询公司也曾被指在报告中出现人工智能错误。 与此同时，全球一些规模最大、收费最高的律师事务所，也已承认在重要法律文件中出现过人工智能生成的错误。 英国大型律师事务所之一 Pinsent Masons 此前承认，其提交给英国高等法院的法律文件中包含人工智能“幻觉”内容。 另一家律师事务所 Sullivan & Cromwell 的律师收费最高可达每小时 3,000 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20,058 元人民币） ，该公司也于今年早些时候承认，提交给纽约一家法院的文件中存在人工智能错误。 埃森哲是众多积极推动员工使用人工智能的专业服务公司之一。 不过，由于员工使用需求过于旺盛，该公司上个月被迫对人工智能工具的使用设置新的限制。此前，部分员工使用 Claude 等工具产生的月度账单超过 1,000 美元 （现汇率约合 6,686 元人民币） 。 埃森哲一名发言人对 GPTZero 的研究结果提出异议，称：“我们的审查表明，报告中发现的错误源于人为失误。没有证据支持这些错误是由人工智能幻觉造成的这一结论。我们正在修正这份报告，并将在重新发布前完成相关工作。我们始终欢迎借此机会进一步提升报告质量。”
items.summary_en: IT Home, November 8: Accenture has been accused of publishing a research report filled with AI 'hallucinations,' containing not only substantial false information but also multiple suspected fabricated case studies. According to a new analysis by GPTZero, a report published by the consulting giant allegedly contains 15 fake citations and entirely fictional case studies, and is therefore under scrutiny. The report, titled 'Leapfrogging Development,' was published by Accenture in collaboration with researchers at IE University in Madrid and aims to explore how AI can improve productivity in Africa's agricultural industry. Accenture denies that the errors were caused by AI. However, the incident may still put Accenture in an awkward position. Previously, the company's management threatened that employees unwilling to use AI could face dismissal. Accenture CEO Julie Sweet warned last year that, as part of the company's AI transformation, consultants who fail to use the technology would be 'eliminated' by the company. GPTZero's report highlights concerns raised by the consulting industry's growing use of AI. One risk is that AI 'hallucinations' may spread false information through chatbot answers and summaries, thereby 'polluting information sources.' GPTZero said: 'The company believes that fabricated citations are an imminent real-world threat to researchers, scholars, consultants, students, and anyone who searches for information via the internet.' This is not the first such incident in the consulting industry. Previously, major consulting firms including Deloitte, EY, KPMG, and PwC have also been accused of AI errors in their reports. At the same time, some of the world's largest and most expensive law firms have acknowledged AI-generated errors in important legal documents. Pinsent Masons, one of the UK's major law firms, previously admitted that legal documents it submitted to the UK High Court contained AI 'hallucinations.' Sullivan & Cromwell, another law firm whose lawyers can charge up to US$3,000 per hour, also admitted earlier this year that documents submitted to a New York court contained AI errors. Accenture is one of many professional services firms actively pushing employees to use AI. However, because employee demand was too strong, the company was forced last month to set new limits on AI tool usage. Previously, some employees' monthly bills for using tools such as Claude exceeded US$1,000. An Accenture spokesperson disputed GPTZero's findings, saying: 'Our review indicates that the errors found in the report stem from human error. There is no evidence to support the conclusion that these errors were caused by AI hallucinations. We are correcting the report and will complete the work before republishing it. We always welcome the opportunity to further improve the quality of our reports.'
items.why_zh: 若 GPTZero 的分析属实，这将凸显专业服务与研究中 AI 生成内容核验的风险；但埃森哲否认 AI 是错误成因（推测）。
items.why_en: If GPTZero's analysis is accurate, it would highlight the risks of verifying AI-generated content in professional services and research; however, Accenture denies that AI caused the errors (speculative).

items.title_en: Google AI research: cuffless hypertension detection with consumer smartwatches, published in Nature
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，当地时间 11 月 5 日，谷歌发布博文，介绍在《自然》（Nature）发表的最新研究成果。 谷歌推出了名为 AI-PPG-ACC-HTN 的多模态 AI 系统。该系统无需袖带校准，使用普通消费级智能手表便能被动检测高血压迹象。 官方表示，与常规方案试图估算极易受瞬时环境噪声干扰的单次瞬时收缩压与舒张压不同，新系统转变了解决思路：通过聚合连续多天采集的被动生理特征， 专注于识别个体潜在且持续存在的高血压状态 。 自监督预训练 ：使用超 49 万小时无标注数据训练 1D-CNN，通过对比学习让模型自主挖掘复杂的心血管生理特征。 多天聚合与分类 ：将多天 15 秒特征向量取均值平滑瞬态噪声，结合身高（表征动脉路径长度），经逻辑回归模型输出持续高血压概率评分。 为评估其性能，研究团队在全美 5 个临床中心开展了前瞻性、多中心临床试验，纳入 196 名无心血管病史且未服降压药的受试者，并以临床金标准 ——24 小时动态血压监测为参照基准。试验结果显示： 初步筛查 ：特异度达 90.0%，阳性预测值（PPV）为 80.6%，灵敏度为 65.8%（优于门诊单次初筛的 55.3% 灵敏度与 77.8% PPV）。 确诊性检测 （针对初筛偏高人群）：PPV 高达 96.7%，特异度达 90.9%，灵敏度达 78.4%，优于门诊复测，更可比肩需佩戴数天的家庭连续袖带监测。 IT之家获悉，该项研究成果已为谷歌健康应用中的血压趋势“健康守护”功能提供核心技术支撑。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, Google published a blog post on Nov 5 introducing research published in Nature: a multimodal AI system called AI-PPG-ACC-HTN can passively detect signs of hypertension using ordinary consumer smartwatches without cuff calibration. Instead of estimating single-time systolic and diastolic blood pressure, which is easily affected by transient environmental noise, the system aggregates passive physiological features collected over multiple consecutive days to identify an individual's persistent hypertensive state. It uses self-supervised pretraining of a 1D-CNN on more than 490,000 hours of unlabeled data, averages multi-day 15-second feature vectors to smooth transient noise, incorporates height, and uses logistic regression to output a persistent hypertension probability score. The team conducted a prospective, multicenter clinical trial at five U.S. clinical centers with 196 participants who had no cardiovascular history and were not taking antihypertensive drugs, using 24-hour ambulatory blood pressure monitoring as the gold standard. Results: initial screening specificity 90.0%, PPV 80.6%, sensitivity 65.8% (better than single clinic screening's 55.3% sensitivity and 77.8% PPV); confirmatory testing PPV 96.7%, specificity 90.9%, sensitivity 78.4%, better than clinic retesting and comparable to multi-day home continuous cuff monitoring. The work provides core technical support for the blood pressure trend “Health Guard” feature in Google's health app.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该被动检测方案在更大规模人群中复现，可能改变高血压筛查的可及性，但仍需监管与临床验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: if this passive detection approach is replicated in larger populations, it could change the accessibility of hypertension screening, but regulatory and clinical validation are still needed.

items.title_zh: 中国科普作家协会发布 2026 年度十大科普热词，AI 相关占据七席
items.title_en: China Science Writers Association releases 2026 top 10 science buzzwords; AI-related terms take seven spots
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，中国科普作家协会今天（7 日）发布了 2026 年度十大科普热词，人工智能相关占据七席，包括 “人工智能 +”“人机协同”“脑机接口”“智能体”“人形机器人”“词元”“具身智能” ，另三大科普热词分别是 “科学玩具”“科技伦理”“健康管理” 。 根据介绍，人工智能相关词汇成为本年度热词的重要组成部分。“人工智能 +”“智能体”“词元”等，反映人工智能 加快融入生产生活带来的新知识需求 ；“脑机接口”“人形机器人”“具身智能”等，为公众 理解前沿技术的原理、进展与应用场景 提供了切入点。 与此同时，“科学玩具”体现科普作品形态的拓展，“人机协同”反映人工智能参与下科普创作的方式变化，“科技伦理”强调技术应用中的责任与价值判断，“健康管理”回应公众对健康知识与科学生活方式的需求。 IT之家附上 2026 年度十大科普热词详细信息如下： NO.01：人工智能 + 以人工智能为核心驱动力，推动人工智能与经济社会各行业各领域广泛深度融合发展，促进生产方式、服务模式和生活方式创新。2025 年，国务院印发《关于深入实施“人工智能 +”行动的意见》，对六大重点行动作出系统部署。2026 年，“人工智能 +”持续深化拓展，在推动技术创新的同时，进一步强调人工智能的规模化应用与实际成效，也对公众理解人工智能、掌握应用方法和识别相关风险提出了新的要求。 NO.02：科学玩具 依据科学技术原理设计，将科学技术知识、原理或方法融入玩乐体验，通过玩耍、观察、实验、测量、建构等一种或多种方式，引导使用者认识相关科学知识、原理或方法，兼具娱乐性和科技教育属性的玩具产品。兼具科学性、趣味性与审美价值，适用于全年龄段群体。2026 年 5 月，中国科普作家协会科学玩具专业委员会成立，推动科学玩具研发、标准建设和产业交流。科学玩具拓展了科普作品的表现形态，也为人们在日常生活中接触科学、体验探究提供了新的载体。 NO.03：人机协同 人类与智能系统通过分工合作、交互反馈和优势互补，共同完成任务的工作方式。人类发挥目标设定、情境理解、价值判断和创造性思考等优势，智能系统提供信息处理、内容生成和自动化执行等支持，协同效果取决于任务分配、过程监督和结果校验。在科普创作中，人机协同可贯穿资料整理、内容构思和多形态表达等环节，同时要求创作者承担科学判断与质量把关责任。 NO.04：脑机接口 在脑与外部设备之间建立直接信息通道，实现脑活动信息与机器指令转换和交互的技术。它不依赖肌肉和外周神经，通过采集、处理和解码脑信号，支持交流沟通、设备控制或康复训练等任务，主要技术路径有侵入式、半侵入式和非侵入式。2026 年，《政府工作报告》将脑机接口列入培育发展的未来产业。作为生命科学与信息科学交叉融合的前沿领域，脑机接口为功能辅助和康复带来新的可能，其实际能力与适用条件仍需持续验证，脑数据隐私保护和应用伦理边界也需进一步明确。 NO.05：智能体 能够感知环境，并利用工具采取行动，以实现特定目标的智能系统。随着大模型技术发展，基于大模型的智能体可以结合任务规划、工具调用和执行反馈，连续完成信息检索、数据处理和流程操作等多步骤任务，具备自主性、交互性、反应性和适应性，是人工智能从被动问答走向自主行动的重要形态。2026 年，《政府工作报告》首次提出“促进新一代智能终端和智能体加快推广”，《中华人民共和国国民经济和社会发展第十五个五年规划纲要》提出鼓励智能体等技术创新。智能体为知识服务和科普互动提供了新的实现路径。 NO.06：人形机器人 一类在外观结构和运动方式上尽量接近人类、能够模仿人类行为的机器人，通常具有与人类相似的躯干、四肢等身体结构。2026 年，北京亦庄继续举办人形机器人半程马拉松比赛，通过复杂赛道中的连续运行，进一步展示和检验了人形机器人的运动控制、环境适应与系统协同能力。从赛场展示到生产生活应用，人形机器人的发展为公众了解机械设计、运动控制和人工智能等技术及其融合应用提供了窗口，也推动社会更加关注其实际能力与应用条件。 NO.07：科技伦理 科技活动中处理人与人、人与社会、人与自然关系应当遵循的价值理念和行为规范，是促进科技事业健康发展、推动科技进步造福社会的重要保障。它贯穿于科学研究、技术研发、成果应用的全过程，强调增进人类福祉、尊重生命权利、…
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, the China Science Writers Association released its 2026 top 10 science popularization buzzwords that day; seven are AI-related: “AI+”, “human-machine collaboration”, “brain-computer interface”, “agent”, “humanoid robot”, “词元 (token)”, and “embodied intelligence”; the other three are “science toys”, “science and technology ethics”, and “health management”. The association said AI-related terms are an important part of this year's buzzwords: “AI+”, “agent” and “词元” reflect new knowledge needs as AI accelerates integration into production and life; “brain-computer interface”, “humanoid robot” and “embodied intelligence” offer entry points for the public to understand the principles, progress and application scenarios of frontier technologies. Meanwhile, “science toys” reflect the expansion of science popularization formats, “human-machine collaboration” reflects changes in science writing with AI participation, “science and technology ethics” emphasizes responsibility and value judgments in technology application, and “health management” responds to public demand for health knowledge and scientific lifestyles. The summary also lists definitions and policy context, including the State Council's opinion on deeply implementing the “AI+” action, the 2026 Government Work Report listing brain-computer interfaces as a future industry to cultivate and proposing for the first time to promote agents and intelligent terminals, the 15th Five-Year Plan outline encouraging agent technology innovation, and the humanoid robot half-marathon in Beijing Yizhuang.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 神秘模型“立功”，AI 帮助攻克量子计算领域重大难题
items.title_en: Anthropic unreleased model reportedly helps prove major quantum computing conjecture
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（7 日）上午报道，AI 帮助攻克了量子计算领域一项长期悬而未决的重大难题。 物理研究机构 Physical Superintelligence（PSI）宣布，借助 Anthropic 一款尚未发布的 AI 模型， 量子计算领域的阿伦森－安拜尼斯猜想 成功得到证明。 这项猜想自 2008 年提出以来一直未获证明，研究的是量子计算机 在何种条件下能够获得远超传统计算机的运算速度 。 PSI 自行开发了一套 采用 Anthropic 模型的研究系统 ，仅用三天就完成了证明。据其介绍，此次行动意味着“量子计算领域最根本的问题之一”得到解决。 AI 辅助数学研究取得突破的案例还在增加。今年 9 月，OpenAI 宣布解决了有 90 年历史、“数学前沿最深奥的问题之一”的纳维－斯托克斯方程难题。 证明阿伦森－安拜尼斯猜想的研究系统由 PSI 技术人员戴维 · 图尔图雷安开发，系统使用了 Anthropic 尚未发布的 AI 模型。不过，PSI 具体使用了何种模型暂时不得而知。 证明结果显示，量子计算要实现某些指数级的速度优势，必须依赖问题中存在的特殊规律或结构。这也证实了研究人员长期以来的猜测： 量子计算机并非在所有情况下都能获得巨大的性能优势 。 不过，在部分任务上，量子计算机仍能大幅提升运算性能。需要注意的是，量子计算机虽然已经问世，但技术发展仍处于早期阶段。 此前研究过这一猜想的研究人员称，这是一项“重大成果”， 为存在数十年的难题找到了答案 。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, Business Insider reported that morning that AI helped solve a long-standing major problem in quantum computing. Physical Superintelligence (PSI) announced that, using an unreleased Anthropic AI model, the Aaronson–Ambainis conjecture in quantum computing was successfully proved. Proposed in 2008 and previously unproved, the conjecture studies under what conditions quantum computers can achieve computational speeds far beyond classical computers. PSI developed its own research system using the Anthropic model and completed the proof in just three days; which specific model PSI used is not known. The proof indicates that for quantum computing to achieve certain exponential speedups, problems must rely on special structure or regularity, confirming researchers' long-held suspicion that quantum computers do not always have huge performance advantages; however, on some tasks quantum computers can still greatly improve performance. Researchers who previously studied the conjecture called it a “major result” that found an answer to a decades-old problem. The report also says AI-assisted math breakthroughs are increasing, citing OpenAI's September announcement that it solved the 90-year-old Navier–Stokes problem.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该证明获独立验证，可能显示 AI 辅助数学研究加速，但当前仅为机构声明。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the proof is independently verified, it could indicate that AI-assisted mathematical research is accelerating, but currently this is only an institutional claim.

items.title_zh: “超视距安全预警”可识别结冰等危险路况并提示，吉利发布首个车道级气象环境监测大模型
items.title_en: Geely launches first lane-level traffic meteorology large model; “over-the-horizon safety warning” can identify and alert on icing and other dangerous road conditions
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，11 月 5 日，吉利汽车集团与中国气象局地球系统数值预报中心正式签署战略合作框架协议。 双方联合推出行业首个“智象-星睿交通气象大模型”，该模型聚焦结冰、团雾等极端气象场景， 可实现车道级气象环境实时监测与提示 ，为进一步提升复杂天气条件下的行车安全与自动驾驶系统可靠运行提供支撑。 其中针对 能见度骤然下降、暗冰在特定桥面或背阴路段形成、暴雨在局地路段造成积水 等这些“看得见天气、看不清路段”的盲区，目前“智象-星睿交通气象大模型”已初步输出车道级能见度、暗冰和暴雨风险提示产品 ——“超视距安全预警”功能， 可基于多车互联智能识别到结冰等危险路况，并主动提示 。 IT之家获悉，该模型计划 率先在领克 900L 上量产落地 ，未来逐步应用于吉利、银河、领克、极氪等多品牌车型。 此外，明年一季度，吉利汽车集团还将联合中国气象局地球系统数值预报中心发布行业首个“通用气象模型”。 未来，双方还将共同推进《智能网联汽车气象环境数据采集与处理规范》国家标准建议书落地，力争在车载气象观测领域形成适配国内产业实际的技术路径与标准方案。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on Nov 7, on Nov 5 Geely Automobile Group and the China Meteorological Administration Earth System Numerical Prediction Center formally signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement and jointly launched the industry's first “Zhixiang-Xingrui Traffic Meteorology Large Model.” The model focuses on extreme weather scenarios such as icing and patchy fog, enabling real-time lane-level meteorological environment monitoring and alerts to support driving safety and reliable operation of autonomous driving systems in complex weather. For blind spots such as sudden visibility drops, black ice forming on specific bridges or shaded road sections, and heavy rain causing waterlogging on local road segments—where weather is visible but road conditions are not—the model has initially output lane-level visibility, black ice and heavy rain risk alert products under the “over-the-horizon safety warning” function, which can use multi-vehicle connectivity to intelligently identify dangerous road conditions such as icing and proactively alert drivers. The model is planned to enter mass production first on the Lynk 900L, and later be applied gradually to Geely, Galaxy, Lynk and Zeekr brands. In addition, in the first quarter of next year, Geely Automobile Group will jointly release the industry's first “general meteorological model” with the China Meteorological Administration Earth System Numerical Prediction Center. In the future, the two sides will also jointly promote the national standard proposal for “Specification for Collection and Processing of Meteorological Environment Data for Intelligent Connected Vehicles,” aiming to form technical paths and standard solutions suited to China's industrial realities in vehicle-mounted meteorological observation.
items.why_zh: 推测：若车道级气象预警量产落地，可能提升复杂天气下辅助驾驶安全边界，但实际效果待验证。
items.why_en: Speculation: if lane-level weather warnings reach mass production, they could improve the safety envelope of assisted driving in complex weather, but actual effects remain to be verified.

items.title_zh: 量产一个月，上纬新材旗下启元机器人第 10000 台下线
items.title_en: One month into mass production, Swancor's Qiyuan Robotics rolls out its 10,000th unit
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据界面新闻今日，上纬新材启元机器人第 10000 台个人机器人正式下线。继今年 10 月 25 日第 5000 台下线后，启元机器人 14 天累计下线量从 5000 台增至 10000 台。 IT之家注意到，该公司 9 月 20 日正式发售启元 Q1、启元 T1 两款个人机器人， 今年 10 月，启元机器人整机生产工厂正式量产 ，采用“车规标准 +3C 量级”制造体系。 启元 Q1/T1 人形机器人正式售价： 启元 Q1 售价 19,999 元 启元 Q1 探索版售价 26,999 元 启元 T1 售价 19,999 元 启元 T1 Pro 售价 29,999 元 启元 Q1 定位为个人机器人， 身高 88 厘米 ，可折叠放入背包，全身 22 个柔顺力控自由度，支持外观结构件定制，宣称是“全球首个个人机器人”。 启元 Q1 主打自定义特性，支持自定义设计互动动作、3D 打印改造外观，用户可自由调整机器人的外观造型、性格特质、动作姿态与语音音色。 启元 T1 支持轮足人形与四足形态切换， 宣称是“全球首个可变形个人机器人” ，官方现场演示了形态切换。启元 T1 可选五款配色，身高约 100cm，重量约 16kg，续航约 2~3 小时，搭载柔顺力控关节，支持根据路况自动切换形态，还能主动避障、身份识别。
items.summary_en: IT之家 reported on November 8 that, according to Jiemian News today, the 10,000th personal robot from Swancor's Qiyuan Robotics officially rolled off the production line. After the 5,000th unit rolled off on October 25 this year, Qiyuan Robotics' cumulative output rose from 5,000 to 10,000 units in 14 days. IT之家 noted that the company officially began selling two personal robots, Qiyuan Q1 and Qiyuan T1, on September 20; in October this year, Qiyuan Robotics' complete-machine production factory officially entered mass production, adopting an 'automotive-grade standards + 3C volume' manufacturing system. Official prices for the Qiyuan Q1/T1 humanoid robots: Qiyuan Q1 at 19,999 yuan; Qiyuan Q1 Explorer Edition at 26,999 yuan; Qiyuan T1 at 19,999 yuan; Qiyuan T1 Pro at 29,999 yuan. The Qiyuan Q1 is positioned as a personal robot, 88 cm tall, foldable into a backpack, with 22 compliant force-controlled degrees of freedom across the body, support for custom exterior structural parts, and is claimed to be 'the world's first personal robot.' The Qiyuan Q1 focuses on customization, supporting custom-designed interactive actions and 3D-printed exterior modifications; users can freely adjust the robot's appearance, personality traits, action postures, and voice timbre. The Qiyuan T1 supports switching between wheel-legged humanoid and quadruped forms and is claimed to be 'the world's first transformable personal robot'; the company demonstrated the form switching on site. The Qiyuan T1 is available in five color options, is about 100 cm tall, weighs about 16 kg, has about 2–3 hours of battery life, is equipped with compliant force-controlled joints, supports automatic form switching according to road conditions, and can actively avoid obstacles and perform identity recognition.

items.why_en: Speculative: if the production figures are accurate, they suggest an accelerating mass-production pace for personal robots, though actual sales and deliveries are not stated in the summary.

items.title_zh: Menlo Ventures 报告：中国 AI 模型占全球开源模型企业支出 89%，Kimi、DeepSeek、GLM 位列前三
items.title_en: Menlo Ventures report: Chinese AI models account for 89% of global enterprise spending on open-source models, with Kimi, DeepSeek and GLM in the top three
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，据《南华早报》前天报道，一项新研究显示，以月之暗面 Kimi 系列为代表的中国 AI 模型，在全球企业开源模型支出的占比为 89%，接近九成。 IT之家从原报道获悉，硅谷风投公司 Menlo Ventures 近期发布的报告指出上述观点。 其中月之暗面 Kimi 以 61% 份额 ， 在全球企业开源模型支出位居第一 ；深度求索 DeepSeek 以 15% 排名第二；智谱的 GLM 以 11% 位列第三。 相比之下，Meta Platforms 旗下的 Llama 系列是该领域市场份额最高的西方模型，但其在开源模型企业支出中的占比仅为 7%。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 8: According to a South China Morning Post report two days ago, a new study shows that Chinese AI models, represented by Moonshot's Kimi series, account for 89% — nearly nine tenths — of global enterprise spending on open-source models. IT Home learned from the original report that the claim comes from a recently released report by Silicon Valley venture capital firm Menlo Ventures. Moonshot's Kimi ranks first in global enterprise open-source model spending with a 61% share; DeepSeek is second with 15%; Zhipu's GLM is third with 11%. By comparison, Meta Platforms' Llama series is the Western model with the largest share in this segment, but it accounts for only 7% of enterprise open-source model spending.
items.why_zh: 若该数据成立，说明企业开源模型支出明显偏向中国模型；但数据来自单一风投机构报告，尚待独立交叉验证（推测）。
items.why_en: If the figures hold, enterprise open-source model spending would be heavily skewed toward Chinese models; the data comes from a single VC report and has not been independently verified (speculative).

items.title_zh: 曝 ChatGPT 突现封号风波，200 美元 Pro 用户也遭殃
items.title_en: Reports of sudden ChatGPT account bans, including $200 Pro subscribers
items.summary_zh: 北京时间 11 月 8 日，近日多名用户在 Reddit 及 OpenAI 官方开发者社区反映，自己的 ChatGPT 账号突然遭到停用，其中包括每月订阅费用为 200 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 1,338 元人民币） 的 Pro 用户。部分用户表示， 账号被封前没有收到任何通知 ，长期积累的聊天记录和工作资料也因此无法访问。 11 月 7 日，一名用户在 OpenAI 官方开发者社区发帖称，自己的 ChatGPT Pro 账号当天突然被停用，系统显示错误代码“account_deactivated”，但没有收到任何预警或封禁通知邮件。 该用户表示，自己不仅是 ChatGPT Pro 订阅用户，还加入了 OpenAI 的网络安全相关访问计划，账号启用了需要实体安全密钥验证的高级安全设置。他怀疑，封号可能与自己近期通过不同地区的 VPN 节点访问 ChatGPT 和 Codex 有关。不过，这只是用户个人的推测。 OpenAI Support 账号随后在帖子下作出回复，表示由于涉及具体账号信息，无法在公开社区论坛处理账号停用申诉。用户应通过封禁通知邮件中的链接提出申诉；如果没有收到邮件，可以通过官方申诉表单或帮助中心联系客服。该回复并未解释该用户账号被封的具体原因。 Reddit 平台上也出现了类似投诉。11 月 7 日，一名 ChatGPT Pro 用户发帖表示，自己的付费账号突然被停用，收到的理由是账号涉嫌与另一个此前被关闭的账号存在关联。但该用户否认自己拥有或使用过其他账号，并称提交申诉约一小时后就收到了维持封禁决定的回复。 另有用户反映，账号遭到永久停用后，申诉未能成功，原本保存在 ChatGPT 中的笔记、日记等资料也无法继续访问。此前，Reddit 已有用户发帖汇集近期的账号封禁案例，涉及不同类型的使用政策争议。 对于账号封禁，OpenAI 官方帮助中心列出了多种可能原因，包括违反使用政策、绕过安全或访问限制、不当共享账号及 API 密钥、账号安全异常，以及未完成必要的身份验证等。 地区访问限制也是 OpenAI 明确列出的风险之一。根据官方说明，从不受支持的国家或地区访问 ChatGPT 或 OpenAI API，可能导致账号被封禁或暂停。不过，使用不同地区的 VPN 节点并不必然意味着违反地区访问限制，目前尚不能确定相关用户是否因此遭到封禁。 截至发稿，OpenAI 尚未就近期用户集中反映的账号停用问题公布统一解释，也未披露具体受影响人数。现有案例无法证明这些账号属于同一次集中封禁行动，是否存在误封仍有待进一步确认。
items.summary_en: Beijing time, Nov 8: Recently, multiple users on Reddit and OpenAI's official developer community reported that their ChatGPT accounts were suddenly deactivated, including Pro users paying a $200 monthly subscription (IT Home note: about 1,338 yuan at current exchange rates). Some users said they received no notice before the ban and could no longer access long-accumulated chat histories and work materials. On Nov 7, a user posted in OpenAI's official developer community that their ChatGPT Pro account was suddenly deactivated that day, with the system showing error code "account_deactivated", but they received no warning or ban notification email. The user said they were not only a ChatGPT Pro subscriber but also enrolled in an OpenAI cybersecurity-related access program, with advanced security settings requiring a physical security key. They suspect the ban may be related to their recent access to ChatGPT and Codex through VPN nodes in different regions. However, this is only the user's personal speculation. The OpenAI Support account later replied under the post, saying that because it involves specific account information, it cannot handle account deactivation appeals in a public community forum. Users should appeal via the link in the ban notification email; if they did not receive the email, they can contact support through the official appeal form or help center. The reply did not explain the specific reason for the deactivation. Similar complaints appeared on Reddit. On Nov 7, a ChatGPT Pro user posted that their paid account was suddenly deactivated, with the reason given that the account was suspected of being associated with another previously closed account. But the user denied owning or using any other account, and said they received a reply upholding the ban about an hour after submitting an appeal. Other users reported that after permanent deactivation, appeals failed and notes, diaries and other materials stored in ChatGPT were no longer accessible. Previously, Reddit users had posted threads compiling recent account ban cases, involving various types of usage policy disputes. Regarding account bans, OpenAI's official help center lists several possible reasons, including violating usage policies, bypassing security or access restrictions, improper sharing of accounts and API keys, account security anomalies, and failure to complete necessary identity verification. Regional access restrictions are also one of the risks OpenAI explicitly lists. According to official documentation, accessing ChatGPT or the OpenAI API from unsupported countries or regions may result in account suspension or deactivation. However, using VPN nodes in different regions does not necessarily mean violating regional access restrictions, and it cannot currently be determined whether the users involved were banned for this reason. As of publication, OpenAI has not published a unified explanation for the recent concentrated reports of account deactivations, nor disclosed the number of people affected. Existing cases cannot prove these accounts belong to the same concentrated ban action, and whether erroneous bans exist remains to be further confirmed.
items.why_zh: 若集中封号情况属实，付费用户也可能在缺乏通知与解释的情况下失去账号与数据，凸显 AI 服务账号治理与申诉机制的不透明（推测，OpenAI 尚未给出统一说明）。
items.why_en: If the wave of bans is confirmed, paying users may lose accounts and data without notice or explanation, highlighting the opacity of account governance and appeals in AI services (speculative; OpenAI has not issued a unified explanation).

items.title_zh: 特斯拉更新 AI 加速器路线图：SI6 算力达 HW4 的 80 倍，Dojo D3 将面向太空部署
items.title_en: Tesla updates AI accelerator roadmap: SI6 compute to reach 80x HW4, Dojo D3 aimed at space deployment
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，特斯拉公布了更新后的 AI 加速器路线图，进一步揭示了公司未来几年的芯片研发方向。根据这份路线图，特斯拉第六代推理加速器的算力预计将达到现有第四代芯片的 80 倍；而用于训练任务的 Dojo D3 将放弃以 SRAM 为核心的架构，转向采用多芯粒设计，并搭载堆叠式 HBM 高带宽内存。 此外，特斯拉还开始用“超级智能”（Super Intelligence，SI）取代“人工智能”（Artificial Intelligence，AI）这一名称，为旗下 AI 加速器启用 SI 系列命名。出于相同原因，马斯克近期也确认，SpaceXAI 将更名为 SpaceXSI。 特斯拉 AI 加速器路线图 根据披露的信息，特斯拉目前的芯片产品线及规划如下： 项目 HW3 / AI3 SI4 / HW4 SI5 / AI5 SI6 / AI6 Dojo D1 Dojo D3 用途 推理 推理 推理 推理 训练 训练 制程工艺 三星 14nm 三星 7nm 台积电 3nm / 三星 2nm 2nm 级 台积电 7nm 待定 架构 单片式 单片式 多芯片模块（MCM） 多芯片模块（MCM） 晶圆级系统（SoW） 多芯粒 封装 FCBGA FCBGA MCM MCM InFO_SoW（训练计算单元） 2.5D + 3D 内存类型 LPDDR4 GDDR6 GDDR6 / GDDR7（待定） GDDR7（待定） 片上 SRAM 堆叠式 HBM 内存容量 8GB 16GB 96GB 144GB 每颗芯片 440MB SRAM；每片晶圆 11GB SRAM 待定 内存带宽 约 68GB/s 约 224GB/s 待定 待定 片上约 10TB/s 待定 相对 SI4 算力 — 1 倍 40 倍 80 倍 — — 预计算力（TOPS） 72 216～576 8640～23040 17280～46080 362 TFLOPS 待定 预计算力（POPS） 0.072 0.216～0.576 8.64～23.04 17.28～46.08 0.362 PFLOPS 待定 当前状态 已淘汰 量产 接近量产 研发中 已停止 研发中 Dojo D3：不再采用晶圆级集成？ IT之家注意到，这份路线图中最值得关注的变化，或许是特斯拉重新启动了自主研发的 Dojo 训练加速器项目。 马斯克曾在 2025 年 8 月取消整个晶圆级 Dojo 项目，并于 2026 年 8 月表示，SpaceX 和 xAI 将在其地面及太空数据中心中全部采用英伟达硬件。不过，第三代 Dojo D3 与前两代 Dojo D1、Dojo D2 将有明显不同。 特斯拉将下一代 Dojo D3 描述为一款基于芯粒（Chiplet）的训练加速器，采用 2.5D 和 3D 封装技术，并搭载堆叠式 HBM 内存。 这与最初 Dojo D1 采用的晶圆级系统（System-on-Wafer，SoW）架构有很大不同。D1 主要依赖分布式片上 SRAM，并通过晶圆级封装技术，将 25 颗 D1 处理器连接起来，提供总计 11GB 的 SRAM。 D3 转向 HBM，意味着特斯拉希望大幅提高内存容量。现代 AI 模型需要消耗大量内存，用于存储模型参数、激活值和中间计算数据。从容量角度来看，SRAM 已经不再适合满足这类需求。 采用 HBM 可以让内存容量扩展变得更加容易，但也会带来不同的延迟、带宽、封装和功耗权衡。目前尚不清楚特斯拉是否已经彻底放弃晶圆级集成技术。 一种可能是，特斯拉仍会采用晶圆级封装技术连接逻辑芯片，并在其上方堆叠定制 HBM 模块。 另一种可能是，特斯拉认为晶圆级集成成本过高，只有在 SRAM 主导的特定架构中才具有较高价值。如果在采用晶圆级互连的逻辑芯片上继续堆叠 HBM，还会进一步增加设计复杂度、散热难度和制造难度，可能降低芯片良率，同时带来长期可靠性问题，最终推高成本。 虽然可以通过增加冗余设计、改进制程技术等方式解决其中大部分问题，但这些措施都会增加成本。因此，D3 采用传统芯粒架构而非晶圆级封装的可能性似乎更高。 目前，特斯拉尚未公布 D3 的具体算力、内存容量、制造工艺和研发时间表。 不过，公司表示，Dojo D3 将针对“太空、训练和扩展能力”进行优化。这意味着该产品…
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 8: Tesla published an updated AI accelerator roadmap, further revealing the company's chip R&D direction for the coming years. According to the roadmap, the compute of Tesla's sixth-generation inference accelerator is expected to reach 80 times that of its current fourth-generation chip; the Dojo D3, used for training, will abandon an SRAM-centric architecture in favor of a multi-chiplet design with stacked HBM high-bandwidth memory. In addition, Tesla has begun replacing the term "Artificial Intelligence" (AI) with "Super Intelligence" (SI), using the SI series naming for its AI accelerators. For the same reason, Musk recently confirmed that SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI. Tesla AI accelerator roadmap: according to the disclosed information, Tesla's current chip lineup and plans are as follows. Items: HW3 / AI3, SI4 / HW4, SI5 / AI5, SI6 / AI6, Dojo D1, Dojo D3. Use: inference, inference, inference, inference, training, training. Process: Samsung 14nm, Samsung 7nm, TSMC 3nm / Samsung 2nm, 2nm-class, TSMC 7nm, TBD. Architecture: monolithic, monolithic, multi-chip module (MCM), multi-chip module (MCM), system-on-wafer (SoW), multi-chiplet. Packaging: FCBGA, FCBGA, MCM, MCM, InFO_SoW (training compute unit), 2.5D + 3D. Memory type: LPDDR4, GDDR6, GDDR6 / GDDR7 (TBD), GDDR7 (TBD), on-chip SRAM, stacked HBM. Memory capacity: 8GB, 16GB, 96GB, 144GB, 440MB SRAM per chip and 11GB SRAM per wafer, TBD. Memory bandwidth: about 68GB/s, about 224GB/s, TBD, TBD, about 10TB/s on-chip, TBD. Compute relative to SI4: —, 1x, 40x, 80x, —, —. Pre-computed performance (TOPS): 72, 216–576, 8640–23040, 17280–46080, 362 TFLOPS, TBD. Pre-computed performance (POPS): 0.072, 0.216–0.576, 8.64–23.04, 17.28–46.08, 0.362 PFLOPS, TBD. Current status: discontinued, in mass production, nearing mass production, in development, halted, in development. Dojo D3: no longer using wafer-scale integration? IT Home notes that the most notable change in this roadmap may be that Tesla has restarted its in-house Dojo training accelerator program. Musk canceled the entire wafer-scale Dojo project in August 2025, and said in August 2026 that SpaceX and xAI would use Nvidia hardware entirely in their ground and space data centers. However, the third-generation Dojo D3 will be markedly different from the first two generations, Dojo D1 and Dojo D2. Tesla describes the next-generation Dojo D3 as a chiplet-based training accelerator using 2.5D and 3D packaging and carrying stacked HBM memory. This differs greatly from the system-on-wafer (SoW) architecture used in the original Dojo D1. D1 relied mainly on distributed on-chip SRAM, connecting 25 D1 processors through wafer-level packaging to provide a total of 11GB of SRAM. D3's shift to HBM means Tesla aims to greatly increase memory capacity. Modern AI models consume large amounts of memory to store model parameters, activations and intermediate computation data. In terms of capacity, SRAM is no longer suited to meeting such demands. Adopting HBM makes it easier to scale memory capacity, but brings different latency, bandwidth, packaging and power trade-offs. It is not yet clear whether Tesla has completely abandoned wafer-scale integration. One possibility is that Tesla will still use wafer-level packaging to connect logic chips and stack custom HBM modules on top. Another possibility is that Tesla considers wafer-scale integration too costly, with high value only in specific SRAM-dominated architectures. Continuing to stack HBM on logic chips with wafer-scale interconnects would further increase design complexity, heat dissipation and manufacturing difficulty, potentially lowering chip yield and bringing long-term reliability issues, ultimately raising costs. Although most of these problems can be addressed by adding redundancy or improving process technology, such measures all add cost. Therefore, it seems more likely that D3 will use a conventional chiplet architecture rather than wafer-level packaging. Tesla has not yet disclosed D3's specific compute, memory capacity, manufacturing process or development timeline. items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 8 日消息，特斯拉公布了更新后的 AI 加速器路线图，进一步揭示了公司未来几年的芯片研发方向。根据这份路线图，特斯拉第六代推理加速器的算力预计将达到现有第四代芯片的 80 倍；而用于训练任务的 Dojo D3 将放弃以 SRAM 为核心的架构，转向采用多芯粒设计，并搭载堆叠式 HBM 高带宽内存。 此外，特斯拉还开始用“超级智能”（Super Intelligence，SI）取代“人工智能”（Artificial Intelligence，AI）这一名称，为旗下 AI 加速器启用 SI 系列命名。出于相同原因，马斯克近期也确认，SpaceXAI 将更名为 SpaceXSI。 特斯拉 AI 加速器路线图 根据披露的信息，特斯拉目前的芯片产品线及规划如下： 项目 HW3 / AI3 SI4 / HW4 SI5 / AI5 SI6 / AI6 Dojo D1 Dojo D3 用途 推理 推理 推理 推理 训练 训练 制程工艺 三星 14nm 三星 7nm 台积电 3nm / 三星 2nm 2nm 级 台积电 7nm 待定 架构 单片式 单片式 多芯片模块（MCM） 多芯片模块（MCM） 晶圆级系统（SoW） 多芯粒 封装 FCBGA FCBGA MCM MCM InFO_SoW（训练计算单元） 2.5D + 3D 内存类型 LPDDR4 GDDR6 GDDR6 / GDDR7（待定） GDDR7（待定） 片上 SRAM 堆叠式 HBM 内存容量 8GB 16GB 96GB 144GB 每颗芯片 440MB SRAM；每片晶圆 11GB SRAM 待定 内存带宽 约 68GB/s 约 224GB/s 待定 待定 片上约 10TB/s 待定 相对 SI4 算力 — 1 倍 40 倍 80 倍 — — 预计算力（TOPS） 72 216～576 8640～23040 17280～46080 362 TFLOPS 待定 预计算力（POPS） 0.072 0.216～0.576 8.64～23.04 17.28～46.08 0.362 PFLOPS 待定 当前状态 已淘汰 量产 接近量产 研发中 已停止 研发中 Dojo D3：不再采用晶圆级集成？ IT之家注意到，这份路线图中最值得关注的变化，或许是特斯拉重新启动了自主研发的 Dojo 训练加速器项目。 马斯克曾在 2025 年 8 月取消整个晶圆级 Dojo 项目，并于 2026 年 8 月表示，SpaceX 和 xAI 将在其地面及太空数据中心中全部采用英伟达硬件。不过，第三代 Dojo D3 与前两代 Dojo D1、Dojo D2 将有明显不同。 特斯拉将下一代 Dojo D3 描述为一款基于芯粒（Chiplet）的训练加速器，采用 2.5D 和 3D 封装技术，并搭载堆叠式 HBM 内存。 这与最初 Dojo D1 采用的晶圆级系统（System-on-Wafer，SoW）架构有很大不同。D1 主要依赖分布式片上 SRAM，并通过晶圆级封装技术，将 25 颗 D1 处理器连接起来，提供总计 11GB 的 SRAM。 D3 转向 HBM，意味着特斯拉希望大幅提高内存容量。现代 AI 模型需要消耗大量内存，用于存储模型参数、激活值和中间计算数据。从容量角度来看，SRAM 已经不再适合满足这类需求。 采用 HBM 可以让内存容量扩展变得更加容易，但也会带来不同的延迟、带宽、封装和功耗权衡。目前尚不清楚特斯拉是否已经彻底放弃晶圆级集成技术。 一种可能是，特斯拉仍会采用晶圆级封装技术连接逻辑芯片，并在其上方堆叠定制 HBM 模块。 另一种可能是，特斯拉认为晶圆级集成成本过高，只有在 SRAM 主导的特定架构中才具有较高价值。如果在采用晶圆级互连的逻辑芯片上继续堆叠 HBM，还会进一步增加设计复杂度、散热难度和制造难度，可能降低芯片良率，同时带来长期可靠性问题，最终推高成本。 虽然可以通过增加冗余设计、改进制程技术等方式解决其中大部分问题，但这些措施都会增加成本。因此，D3 采用传统芯粒架构而非晶圆级封装的可能性似乎更高。 目前，特斯拉尚未公布 D3 的具体算力、内存容量、制造工艺和研发时间表。 不过，公司表示，Dojo D3 将针对“太空、训练和扩展能力”进行优化。这意味着该产品…

items.title_en: AI broke the cybersecurity world. What’s next?
items.summary_zh: 节目对话 Cognition 首席安全官、资深网络安全专家 Alex Stamos，谈当下网络安全局面有多糟。这是探讨“AI 在现实生活中的应用”系列特辑的第一部分。Stamos 直言，我们所熟知的、规模达数十亿美元的网络安全产业，在 AI 助推下不断升级的黑客攻击、入侵与数据泄露面前已难以为继，而这只是 AI 改变安全领域的开端。私人行为体与国家行为体（如俄罗斯、朝鲜）借助 AI 同时发现并利用漏洞，正在入侵各地的系统。Stamos 称，这有一种真正的“边疆”感，就像 90 年代“永远在线”的世界刚出现时一样。如此剧烈的颠覆意味着大量可被入侵的缺口，而其他人只能疲于应对。Stamos 长期而言并非末日论者，但他认为，在设法适应新时代的过程中，我们将经历一段“黑暗时代”。节目还谈到社交网络上的 AI 驱动虚假信息与“垃圾内容”可能如何被管理。节目提示订阅 Decoder 的 YouTube 频道；采访经过轻度编辑。
items.summary_en: Today, I’m talking with Alex Stamos, chief security officer at Cognition and longtime cybersecurity expert, about what a mess cybersecurity is right now. This episode is part one of a special series looking at AI in real life. I’ve always enjoyed talking to Alex because he’s so direct, and you’re going to hear him say that the multibillion-dollar cybersecurity industry as we’ve known it is essentially overdue to the unrelenting, AI-boosted waves of hacks, breaches, and attacks — and this is only the beginning of how much AI is changing security. Verge subscribers, don’t forget you get exclusive access to ad-free Decoder wherever you get your podcasts. Head here . Not a subscriber? You can sign up here . Both private actors and also state actors, like Russia or North Korea, are breaking into systems all over thanks to AI helping them both detect and exploit vulnerabilities all at the same time. It’s got a real frontier feel to it, Alex notes, just like the ’90s, when the whole idea of an always-online world was brand-new. That much disruption means a lot of places where bad guys can get in while everyone else is left scrambling. Alex isn’t a doomer in the long run, but he does think we’re in for a “dark age” while we try to figure out how on earth to adapt to the new era. There’s a lot going on here — we even got all the way to how AI-powered misinformation and slop might be managed on our social networks. items.title_zh: 印度 IT 行业领袖警告：AI 或致应届毕业生更难进入科技行业
items.title_en: Indian IT industry leader warns AI could make it harder for graduates to enter tech
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，据日经亚洲 6 日报道，印度最大科技行业协会 —— 印度全国软件与服务公司协会会长拉杰什 · 南比亚尔警告，随着 AI 逐渐接手基础编程和软件测试工作，印度应届大学毕业生进入科技行业 可能更加困难 。 南比亚尔认为，求职难的问题，可能要等到 印度软件出口企业适应新的商业环境 后才能缓解。随着技术基础设施管理等传统核心业务的工作量减少，企业需要开拓网络安全、AI 咨询、技术部署及维护等新业务，弥补由此造成的业务缺口。 他进一步指出，软件企业的收费模式正从按项目投入人数计费转向按实际成果收费，应届毕业生的求职门槛也会随之改变。 因此，高校需要调整计算机专业课程，否则印度可能出现 数以千计的工科毕业生 ，所学技能却无法满足企业需求。“对刚毕业的学生来说，这确实是个令人担忧的问题，我不想粉饰这一点。如果我们的教育体系不能尽快跟上变化， 学生可能一毕业就发现，自己学到的技能早就过时了 。…… 课程体系从未像现在这样需要如此大幅度的改革。” 官方估算显示，在截至今年 3 月的财年，印度共有 5903 所工程与技术类院校 ，入学人数接近 260 万人。由于科技行业薪资丰厚，许多人将科技岗位视为实现经济富裕的途径。 但即使 AI 时代还处于起步阶段，印度也面临严峻的大学生就业问题。阿齐姆 · 普莱姆吉大学估计，2004 年至 2023 年，印度失业大学毕业生人数 增加至原来的近 4 倍，达到约 1100 万人 。 IT之家从报道中获悉，南比亚尔认为，印度软件行业正 经历一场“再平衡” ，调整还会持续一段时间，直到 AI 业务增长足以弥补传统 IT 基础设施维护业务的收入损失。“这个过程中难免会时不时遇到阵痛，但只要跨过这个难关，几年后再回头看，我认为结果会非常非常好。” 不过，随着整个行业向 AI 转型，部分企业仍可能面临生存压力。“整个行业能否生存下去，基本没有悬念，真正的问题在于各家企业。” 南比亚尔相信，80% 至 85% 的企业能够继续生存，但一些企业或许会因为过于习惯过去的经营方式，难以顺利完成转型。“企业必须主动改革自身业务，否则就无法适应新时代。”
items.summary_en: Nikkei Asia reported on November 6 that Rajesh Nambiar, chairman of Nasscom — India's largest tech industry association — warned that it may become harder for Indian university graduates to enter the tech sector as AI increasingly takes over basic programming and software testing work. Nambiar said the hiring difficulty may ease only after Indian software exporters adapt to the new business environment. As work in traditional core businesses such as tech infrastructure management shrinks, companies need to develop new businesses such as cybersecurity, AI consulting, and technology deployment and maintenance to fill the gap. He further noted that software firms' charging models are shifting from billing by the number of people assigned to a project toward charging for actual outcomes, which will also change the bar for graduates. Universities therefore need to adjust computer science curricula, otherwise India could end up with thousands of engineering graduates whose skills do not meet company needs. "For fresh graduates this is genuinely a worrying problem, and I don't want to sugarcoat it. If our education system cannot keep up with the changes quickly, students may find the skills they learned are already outdated the moment they graduate... Curricula have never needed such substantial reform as they do now." Official estimates show India had 5,903 engineering and technology institutions with nearly 2.6 million enrolled students in the fiscal year ending in March. Because tech sector pay is high, many people see tech jobs as a path to economic prosperity. But even though the AI era is only beginning, India already faces a severe graduate employment problem. Azim Premji University estimates that the number of unemployed university graduates in India roughly quadrupled between 2004 and 2023, reaching about 11 million. Nambiar believes the Indian software industry is undergoing a "rebalancing" that will continue for some time, until AI business growth is enough to offset revenue lost from traditional IT infrastructure maintenance. "There will inevitably be pain from time to time in this process, but as long as we get past this hurdle, I think the results will be very, very good when we look back in a few years." However, as the whole industry shifts toward AI, some companies may still face existential pressure. "There is basically no doubt about whether the industry as a whole will survive; the real question is individual companies." Nambiar believes 80% to 85% of companies can continue to survive, but some may struggle to complete the transition because they are too used to the old way of doing business. "Companies must proactively reform their own businesses, otherwise they cannot adapt to the new era."
items.why_zh: 推测：印度是全球最大 IT 外包市场之一，行业协会公开预警毕业生就业与课程改革压力，可能成为 AI 冲击入门级技术岗位的一个观察样本。
items.why_en: Speculation: India is one of the world's largest IT outsourcing markets, and an industry body's public warning about graduate employment and curriculum reform could serve as an observable test case for AI's impact on entry-level tech jobs.

items.title_en: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 正在用 AI 来构建更强大的 AI，而且似乎成效显著：公司模型的改进速度约为一年前的两倍，几乎没有放缓的迹象。这来自 AI 安全研究机构 METR 于周四发布的一份新报告，该机构为评估 Anthropic 的 AI 研发工作，在公司内部进行了为期 11 周的调查。这项调查与另一项计划是分开的，后者是在今年夏天多起备受关注的入侵事件之后，向安全研究人员提供“类似员工”的系统访问权限。这些发现提供了迄今关于 AI……（原文此处截断）的最清晰证据之一。完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei. | Photo: Jason Henry/Bloomberg via Getty Images Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI. And it appears to be working remarkably well, with the company's models improving roughly twice as quickly as a year ago, with little indication of slowing down. That's according to a new report published Thursday by the AI safety research organization METR, following an 11-week investigation inside the company, as part of a report evaluating its AI research and development. The probe is separate from a program offering safety researchers "employee-like" access to systems in the wake of high-profile hacking incidents over the summer. The findings offer some of the clearest evidence yet of AI … Read the full story at The Verge.

items.title_zh: 马斯克“御用”律师斯皮罗：AI 有望让案件尽快和解或直接走上法庭
items.title_en: Musk lawyer Alex Spiro says AI could push cases to settle quickly or go straight to trial
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，据《商业内幕》今天（7 日）凌晨报道，马斯克经常聘请的知名律师、昆鹰律师事务所纽约办公室合伙人亚历克斯 · 斯皮罗认为，AI 有望大幅精简法律行业的冗余诉讼程序， 让更多案件迅速和解，或直接走上法庭 。 斯皮罗指出，AI 工具可以帮助律师更快判断一起案件是否值得打官司。“我认为， AI 能省去许多工作中不必要的环节 ，连我的工作也不例外。省掉这些环节，就能更快查清事实、梳理信息。有了这些信息，我们就能尽早判断，案件究竟应该和解，还是坚持打到底。” 斯皮罗曾为演员亚历克 · 鲍德温、说唱歌手 Jay-Z、新英格兰爱国者队老板罗伯特 · 克拉夫特，以及前纽约市长埃里克 · 亚当斯担任代理律师。 他认为，AI 有望减少案件长期陷入诉讼、耗费大量时间和金钱的情况，“或许大量繁琐的中间程序都会被省掉， 案件要么尽快和解，要么直接打到法庭上 ，不必再经历那么多毫无意义、在和解与开庭之间反复拉扯的诉讼程序。” AI 还有望让更多案件进入庭审，因为律师可以更快分析案情，判断哪些案件值得继续争取。“说不定开庭审理的案件反而会更多。因为大家可以说：‘好，我们刚刚分析了 10 起案件，9 起应该和解，剩下 1 起不能和解，必须打到底。’ 这样就不会那么顾虑重重 。有些公司明明认为‘这 3 起案件得打到法庭上’，最后却因为太害怕风险而选择妥协。” 不过，斯皮罗强调， AI 不会改变他的诉讼策略 。“20 年来，我打官司的方式，以及在陪审团面前陈述的方式都没变。有些辩论技巧管用，有些就是不管用。陪审员也不会因为 AI 而改变。所以，我还是会用原来的方式和他们交流。变化的只是为我搜集资料、供我整理成辩论观点的人可能不需要那么多了，或者有了技术工具，他们获取信息的过程可以更加简单直接，工作也能完成得更快、更高效。” 当被问到 AI 会不会让客户过分相信自己的法律判断时，斯皮罗打趣说，这种情况他再熟悉不过了：“我代理的客户几乎个个都觉得自己更懂法律。这正是我的专长。”
items.summary_en: Business Insider reported early on November 7 that Alex Spiro, a prominent lawyer frequently hired by Elon Musk and a partner in Quinn Emanuel's New York office, believes AI could substantially streamline redundant litigation procedures in the legal industry, allowing more cases to settle quickly or go straight to trial. Spiro said AI tools can help lawyers determine faster whether a case is worth litigating. "I think AI can cut out a lot of unnecessary steps in the work, including my own work. Cutting those steps means finding the facts and organizing information faster. With that information, we can decide early on whether a case should settle or be fought to the end." Spiro has represented actor Alec Baldwin, rapper Jay-Z, New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft and former New York Mayor Eric Adams. He believes AI could reduce cases that get stuck in prolonged litigation at great cost in time and money: "Maybe a lot of the tedious intermediate procedures will be cut, and cases will either settle quickly or go straight to court, without going through so many pointless back-and-forth procedures between settling and going to trial." AI may also bring more cases to trial, because lawyers can analyze cases faster and judge which ones are worth pursuing. "Maybe more cases will actually go to trial. Because people can say: 'Okay, we just analyzed 10 cases, nine should settle and the remaining one cannot settle and must be fought to the end.' That way there is less hesitation. Some companies clearly think 'these three cases need to go to court' but ultimately compromise because they are too afraid of the risk." Spiro stressed, however, that AI will not change his litigation strategy. "For 20 years, the way I argue cases and the way I present to juries has not changed. Some advocacy techniques work and some just don't. Jurors won't change because of AI either. So I will still communicate with them the same way. What changes is that I may need fewer people gathering materials for me to organize into arguments, or with technical tools their information gathering can be simpler and more direct, and the work can be done faster and more efficiently." Asked whether AI might make clients overconfident in their own legal judgment, Spiro joked that he knows that situation well: "Almost every client I represent thinks they know the law better. That is exactly my specialty."

items.title_en: Zhang Yimou on AI's impact on film: AI short-video output value has reached tens of billions of yuan, a major challenge

items.summary_en: According to the Movie Channel's media center, a Jinji · International Film Festival dialogue at the 39th China Golden Rooster Awards opened in Xiamen, where Zhang Yimou, as the main guest, shared his views on AI's impact on the film industry. Zhang said AI short videos already have an output value of tens of billions of yuan and are watched by a great many people — so will people still go to cinemas? He acknowledged that this is a major challenge, and that he does not know what to do in the future (say, five or ten years from now) when AI technology fully surpasses humans. He advised young directors to focus on themselves, to learn, accumulate and improve, and to tell the stories in their hearts with a positive attitude toward life, drawing on the original aspiration they feel most deeply. That, he said, may be the only thing we can do. Separately, earlier reports said that on November 5, a relevant official of the National Radio and Television Administration reiterated in Beijing that the administration's stance on the relationship between live-action micro-dramas and AI micro-dramas is very clear: support live-action dramas and regulate AI dramas. Speaking at the micro-drama forum of the 2026 China Radio and Television Fine Works Creation Conference that day, the official said that for micro-dramas, AI brings not only cost reduction and efficiency gains in production but also systemic change in production methods, industry form and development logic. From scriptwriting to shooting and production, from distribution to overseas operations, the entire chain is being reshaped, and new creation models and a new industrial ecosystem are emerging; the whole industry should be good at grasping and using this, so that AI can serve as a helper for fine creation and an engine for innovative development.

items.title_zh: 苹果披露人形机器人 HALO 系统：调用千问模型在宇树 G1 上验证，单项任务平均成功率 91%
items.title_en: Apple details HALO humanoid robot system: uses Qwen models on Unitree G1, 91% average success on single tasks
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 7 日消息，当地时间 11 月 4 日，苹果研究团队在预印本平台 arXiv 提交论文《Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation》，披露了人形机器人自主控制系统 HALO。 研究团队还公开了数据生成、模型训练和部署代码，涵盖动作生成、动作跟踪、任务编排以及仿真和真实机器人运行等环节。 在落地阶段， 研究团队采用宇树科技 G1 人形机器人 ，背部加装了专用 3D 打印保护外壳， 内置一台 Mac mini （M4 Pro 芯片，64GB 统一内存），Mac mini 负责在机载端实时推理计算开销较大的 Orchestrator（VLM）与 Motion Generator（DiT）；G1 自带的板载芯片则专注高频运行 Tracker（RL 策略网络）。 执行任务时，HALO 由三个层级协同控制。最上层是基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的任务编排模块，默认采用千问 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，系统也可选择通过 API 调用云端模型；中间的动作生成层采用另一款千问模型 Qwen3.5-2B；底层则是经强化学习、策略蒸馏等步骤训练的动作跟踪器，以每秒 50 次的频率运行。 据论文披露， 研究团队在 6 个未预先扫描或建图的真实环境中开展 360 次单项任务测试，平均成功率为 91% 。 针对长序列复合任务，在单一真实场景，各进行 10 次测试，3 种组合平均成功率为 70%；其中最复杂的“俯身通过障碍 — 走向目标 — 推箱子”10 次测试成功 5 次，成功率为 50%。 据介绍，研究团队使用 250 张英伟达 H100 GPU，耗时约 48 小时合成主要训练数据。动作生成器通过模仿学习训练，使用 64 张 B200；动作跟踪器经强化学习、策略蒸馏等步骤训练，使用 4 张 H100。 不过，仿真生成数据并未完全摆脱人工参与。团队表示新增物理任务仍需人工编写提示词、设计动作关键帧，部分动作还使用了人类视频或动捕素材。 研究团队同时指出，目前机器人主要依赖视觉感知，难以直接感知接触情况；当物体离开相机视野或被遮挡时，涉及较多接触的任务表现会下降。加入触觉感知将是后续改进方向之一。 IT之家附相关链接： 论文： https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06908 项目主页： https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-halo/ GitHub 仓库： https://github.com/apple-aiml-research/ml-halo
items.summary_en: On November 4 local time, Apple's research team submitted the paper "Perceptive Humanoid Motion from Simulation" to the preprint platform arXiv, detailing HALO, an autonomous control system for humanoid robots. The team also released code for data generation, model training and deployment, covering motion generation, motion tracking, task orchestration, and simulation and real-robot operation. For the deployment stage, the team used Unitree's G1 humanoid robot with a custom 3D-printed protective shell on its back housing a Mac mini (M4 Pro chip, 64GB unified memory); the Mac mini handles on-board real-time inference for the computationally heavy Orchestrator (VLM) and Motion Generator (DiT), while the G1's own onboard chip focuses on running the high-frequency Tracker (RL policy network). During task execution, HALO is controlled cooperatively across three levels. The top level is a vision-language model (VLM)-based task orchestration module, which by default uses Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, and the system can alternatively call cloud models via API; the middle motion generation layer uses another Qwen model, Qwen3.5-2B; the bottom layer is a motion tracker trained through reinforcement learning and policy distillation, running at 50 times per second. According to the paper, the team ran 360 single-task tests in six real environments that were not pre-scanned or mapped, with an average success rate of 91%. For long-sequence composite tasks, 10 tests each were run in a single real scene, with an average success rate of 70% across three combinations; the most complex one — "duck under an obstacle, walk to the target, push the box" — succeeded 5 times out of 10, a 50% success rate. The team used 250 Nvidia H100 GPUs and about 48 hours to synthesize the main training data. The motion generator was trained via imitation learning using 64 B200 GPUs; the motion tracker was trained through reinforcement learning, policy distillation and other steps using 4 H100 GPUs. However, simulation-generated data has not fully eliminated human involvement. The team said new physical tasks still require humans to write prompts and design motion keyframes, and some motions used human videos or motion-capture footage. The team also noted that the robot currently relies mainly on visual perception and cannot directly sense contact; when objects leave the camera's field of view or are occluded, performance on tasks involving more contact degrades. Adding tactile sensing will be one direction for future improvement. Links: paper https://arxiv.org/2611.06908; project page https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-halo/; GitHub repo https://github.com/apple-aiml-research/ml-halo

items.summary_en: Massive new data centers are the physical foundation for tech companies’ hopes and dreams for AI. But the rush to expand warehouses full of energy-hungry servers has also kicked up fights across the world over their impact on power grids, utility bills, nearby communities, and the environment. Data centers were a major bipartisan issue ahead of the 2026 midterms , and voters largely opposed data center expansion at the polls. Tech giants like OpenAI and Amazon are promising to work more closely with local communities and cover their data center energy costs. But following the election, Democratic leaders are calling for further data center restrictions and slowdowns that the AI companies will have to grapple with. From audacious plans about data centers into space , heated local battles over buildouts , and potential environmental impacts , here’s The Verge ’s news, coverage, and reporting surrounding data centers and the companies that are building them. Lame-duck Congress might actually do something: speed up energy projects “We are a data center first company,” AMD CEO Lisa Su says. OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects This week in the big AI data center buildout. Data centers lost the midterms Maine Republican Susan Collins concedes Senate seat in a tech-fueled race. Democrat projected to win Ohio seat that Republicans warned could spell trouble for data centers. Data center-dense Texas turns blue. But the rush to expand warehouses full of energy-hungry servers has also kicked up fights across the world over their impact on power grids, utility bills, nearby communities, and the environment. Data centers were a major bipartisan issue ahead of the 2026 midterms , and voters largely opposed data center expansion at the polls. Tech giants like OpenAI and Amazon are promising to work more closely with local communities and cover their data center energy costs. But following the election, Democratic leaders are calling for further data center restrictions and slowdowns that the AI companies will have to grapple with. From audacious plans about data centers into space , heated local battles over buildouts , and potential environmental impacts , here’s The Verge ’s news, coverage, and reporting surrounding data centers and the companies that are building them. Lame-duck Congress might actually do something: speed up energy projects “We are a data center first company,” AMD CEO Lisa Su says. OpenAI is stepping back from NDAs for data center projects This week in the big AI data center buildout. Data centers lost the midterms Maine Republican Susan Collins concedes Senate seat in a tech-fueled race. Democrat projected to win Ohio seat that Republicans warned could spell trouble for data centers. Data center-dense Texas turns blue. items.title_zh: 我围观一台人形机器人打扫公寓，感觉像是提前体验了未来
items.title_en: I watched a humanoid robot clean my apartment. It felt like a taste of the future.
items.summary_zh: 我不是那种通常会花钱请保洁的人。我太节俭了，而且多少享受戴上耳机听播客、拿魔术海绵猛擦浴缸的过程。但当我在 X 上看到旧金山一项新的人形机器人清洁服务后，立刻加入了等候名单。我希望自己的公寓哪怕只有一小时也像《杰森一家》那样。我也是出于报道兴趣。为了保证体验真实，我没有告诉发布那条 X 帖的创业公司 Tau Robotics 我是记者——不过我用了真名，所以也可能有人查过我。Tau 的长期目标是让自主清洁机器人成为现实，但目前还没做到：眼下这些机器人由人远程操控，操作者通过装在机器人头部和手腕上的摄像头观察现场。机器人在清洁过程中收集数据，Tau 将用这些数据训练它们更独立的“后代”。每一次成功擦净的台面、每一件成功叠好的 T 恤，都会帮助驱动机器人的模型在下一轮做得更好。由于这些数据对 Tau 很有价值，公司收取的清洁费用低于人们对这类前沿产品的一般预期。我预约时，Tau 对单台机器人一小时清洁的收费是 30 美元；现在的价格是两台机器人每周清洁 60 美元，或一次性上门 100 美元。但即便按每小时 30 美元的较低价格，Tau 的机器人也不算划算。它们干得仔细但很慢，所以如果你像我一样，忍不住在它们上门全程站在旁边围观，那还不如自己动手打扫更省时间。不过这些机器人在物理上确实有能力清洁，而且不可否认地可爱。Tau 的机械臂……
items.summary_en: I’m not the sort of person who typically pays for a house cleaner. I’m too frugal, and I kind of enjoy putting on a podcast and going to town on my tub with a Magic Eraser. But when I saw an X post about a new humanoid-robot cleaning service in San Francisco, I immediately signed up for the waitlist. I wanted my apartment to feel like The Jetsons , even if just for an hour. I was also motivated by journalistic interest. In order to ensure an authentic experience, I didn’t tell Tau Robotics, the startup behind the X post, that I was a journalist—though I did use my real name, so it’s possible someone looked me up. Tau’s long-term goal is to make autonomous cleaning robots a reality, but they’re not quite there yet: For now, the robots are piloted remotely by humans, who watch what’s going on via cameras mounted in the robots’ heads and wrists. As the robots clean, they collect data that Tau will use to train up their more independent descendants. Every counter successfully wiped and T-shirt successfully folded will help the models that power the robots learn to do better on the next go-round. Because this data is so valuable to Tau, the company charges less for cleaning than one might expect for such a cutting-edge product. At the time I booked, Tau was offering $30 for an hourlong cleaning with a single robot; now the charge is $60 per weekly cleaning with two robots, or $100 for a one-time visit. But even at the cheaper rate of $30 per hour, Tau’s robots aren’t a great bargain. They are thorough but slow, so if you, like me, are tempted to stand around watching them for their entire visit, it would probably be a better use of your time to just take care of the cleaning yourself.
